claim.claim-text: 1. A method, comprising:
2. The method of claim 1, further comprising receiving the one or more second quality scores generated by the one or more other electronic devices.
3. The method of any of the preceding claims, further comprising communicating, by the electronic device, the first quality score to the one or more other electronic devices.

4. The method of claim 3, wherein the electronic device is connected to the one or more other electronic devices via a local network, and wherein communicating the first quality score comprises communicating, by the electronic device, the first quality score to the one or more other electronic devices via the local network.

5. The method of any of the preceding claims, wherein outputting the response to the voice input comprises outputting, by the electronic device, one or more of an audible response or a visual response to the voice input.
6. The method of any of the preceding claims, further comprising:

transmitting, to a server, the voice input or a processed version of the voice input, wherein the server generates the response to the voice input based on the voice input or the processed version of the voice input; and receiving, from the server, the response to the voice input.

7. The method of any of the preceding claims, wherein determining the first quality score for the voice input comprises determining, by the processor, the first quality score for the voice input based on at least one of: a loudness or amplitude of the voice input, a presence or absence of noise in the voice input, a presence or absence of distortion in the voice input, or a frequency profile of the voice input.
8. A system comprising:
9. The system of claim 8, the operations further comprising accessing the one or more second quality scores generated by the one or more other electronic devices.

10. The system of any of claims 8 to 9, wherein outputting the response to the voice input comprises outputting, by the first electronic device, one or more of an audible response or a visual response to the voice input.

11. The system of any of claims 8 to 10, wherein determining the first quality score for the voice input comprises determining, by the processor, the first quality score for the voice input based on at least one of: a loudness or amplitude of the voice input, a presence or absence of noise in the voice input, a presence or absence of distortion in the voice input, or a frequency profile of the voice input.
12. A non-transitory computer-readable medium comprising instructions that, when executed by one or more processors, cause the one or more processors to perform operations comprising:

13. The non-transitory computer-readable medium of claim 12, comprising additional instructions that, when executed by the one or more processors, cause the one or more processors to perform additional operations comprising receiving the one or more second quality scores generated by the one or more other electronic devices.

14. The non-transitory computer-readable medium of any of claims 12 to13, wherein outputting the response to the voice input comprises outputting, by the electronic device, one or more of an audible response or a visual response to the voice input.

15. The non-transitory computer-readable medium of any of claims 12 to 14, wherein determining the first quality score for the voice input comprises determining, by the processor, the first quality score for the voice input that was detected based on at least one of: a loudness or amplitude of the voice input, a presence or absence of noise in the voice input, a presence or absence of distortion in the voice input, or a frequency profile of the voice input.
